question: Where is the nearest café ahead of Mentor Civic Arena, Mentor, OH toward Bottle & Bottega, North Olmsted, OH?
sql: WITH origin AS ( SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%Mentor Civic Arena%' LIMIT 1 ), target AS ( SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%Bottle & Bottega%' LIMIT 1 ) SELECT p.poi_name FROM pois AS p, origin, target WHERE p.amenity = 'cafe' AND origin.geometry IS NOT NULL AND target.geometry IS NOT NULL -- Filter cafes to be within a 90-degree cone (45 degrees either side) -- in the direction from the origin to the target. AND ( SELECT LEAST( ABS(degrees(ST_Azimuth(origin.geometry, p.geometry)) - degrees(ST_Azimuth(origin.geometry, target.geometry))), 360 - ABS(degrees(ST_Azimuth(origin.geometry, p.geometry)) - degrees(ST_Azimuth(origin.geometry, target.geometry))) ) ) <= 45 ORDER BY ST_Distance(origin.geometry, p.geometry::geography) ASC LIMIT 1;
